note: Generated by scripts/studio-words.mjs from web/studio/parts/*-words.js. Do not edit: run the script.

vars.helper: the person who set up your site

about.aliasFix.text: An old address in this post can't be used. {helper} can fix it in the file.

add.asWrittenHelp.text: Everything exactly as it's saved. Turn this off to see cards again.

add.detailsNote.text: Everything here writes ordinary Markdown into content/posts/{file}. Pieces are checked and written by {product} (POST /admin/api/pieces), so the file holds exactly what the build reads.

add.nothingHelp.text: Try another word, or close this and keep writing.

add.slashTip.text: Tip: type / on an empty line to add something.

add.whereEnd.text: It goes at the end of {box}.

add.whereStart.text: It goes at the start of {box}.

add.wordsHelp.text: Leave an empty line between paragraphs. For a list, start each line with a dash (-). Photos, tips and tables show as cards: change them with their buttons.

bluesky.nameError.text: Type your Bluesky name, like yourname.bsky.social.

card.asWritten.text: Change it in the words as written

card.cantChange.text: This one can't be changed here. {helper} can.

card.elsewhere.text: This photo is on another website.

card.unclosed.text: Part of this post is open as written

card.unclosedLine.text: A code block starting on line {line} never ends.

card.unclosedWhy.text: So nothing in it gets moved around.

cards.notSetUp.text: {helper} needs to finish setting them up. Your site works the same without them.

check.allCaps.text: This is all in capital letters, which can read like shouting.

check.emptyAddress.text: A link doesn't go anywhere yet.

check.emptyLink.text: A link has no words, so no one can tell where it goes.

check.headingSkip.text: This heading is smaller than it should be after the one before it.

check.html.text: Line {line} has an HTML tag. It is kept and shown as written.

check.insecure.text: This web address starts with http://. Most sites also work with https://, which is safer.

check.longParagraph.text: This paragraph is {count} words long. Shorter ones are easier to read on a phone.

check.photoDescription.text: A photo has no description, so people who can't see it won't know what it shows.

check.vagueLink.text: The link “{words}” doesn't say where it goes. Words that name the place are easier to follow.

common.keepsHappening.text: Try again, and if it keeps happening, tell {helper}.

copy.notReady.text: Your blog can't make a copy for it right now. Try another, or tell {helper}.

decorations.betweenOff.text: The look {product} wears while the calendar is off.

decorations.byItself.text: {product} changes by itself on the days below.

decorations.calendarOff.text: {product} wears {theme} every day. The calendar is off.

decorations.noSeasons.text: Add one, like Christmas from December 1 to January 6, and {product} changes by itself.

decorations.putUpEarly.text: {product} is decorated for {theme}, put up early. It stays up through {until}.

decorations.whenYouSave.text: When you save, {product} wears {theme} every day. Your seasons are kept for when you turn this back on.

did.cantMoveDown.text: This is already at the end.

did.cantMoveUp.text: This is already at the top.

did.movedTop.text: Moved up. It's now at the top.

did.undone.text: Taken back. Your words are as they were.

form.addThisText.text: You filled it in but didn't add it.

form.badAddress.text: That needs to be a web address starting with https://, or one of your posts.

form.badEmail.text: That doesn't look like an email address.

form.badVideo.text: That isn't a YouTube or Vimeo link. Copy it from Share under the video.

form.cantAddYet.text: {product} can't add this yet. {helper} can update it.

form.checkHelp.text: Check what you filled in against the help under each box.

form.keepChangesText.text: You changed it but didn't press Done.

form.linkAddress.text: That needs to be a web address, starting with https://.

form.mapLinkHelp.text: In OpenStreetMap or Google Maps, find the place, then copy the address from the top of the page.

form.mapNone.text: That link doesn't say where the place is.

form.mapShort.text: That's a short link, which doesn't say where the place is. Open it, then copy the long address from the top of the page.

form.moved.text: This changed while the form was open. Close it and try again.

form.needColumn.text: Give at least one column a name.

form.needDescribe.text: Describe the photo so everyone knows what it shows.

form.needHttps.text: A full web address, starting with https://.

form.needThings.text: Write something on each line, or take the empty ones out.

form.needVideoAbout.text: Say what the video is about.

form.noAnswer.text: {product} didn't answer, so it isn't in yet. What you filled in is kept.

form.noTags.text: This can't hold code like <b>. Take out the part with < and >.

form.noTicks.text: This can't have three ` marks in a row.

form.offMap.text: That map link points somewhere off the map. Copy it again.

form.penBad.text: That isn't a CodePen address. It looks like https://codepen.io/name/pen/…

form.photoNoSignal.text: Your photos show here when there's a signal.

form.photoNone.text: There are no photos on your site yet. Add one above.

form.photoOnSite.text: Or use one already on your site

form.postsNeedSignal.text: Your posts show here when there's a signal.

form.quizNeedAnswers.text: Fill in each answer, or take it out.

form.quizNoLinks.text: A question for readers can't hold links or photos.

form.runNeed.text: Fill in title, what to try and code.

form.runNeedExpected.text: A challenge needs its expected result.

form.runTodo.text: A challenge's starter code needs a TODO comment.

form.runWebParts.text: Web code needs a ---html, ---css or ---js part.

form.seeItNote.text: Only you can see this. Nothing is added until you press Add it.

form.tooMuch.text: That's too much to add at once. Split it into two.

form.videoAboutHelp.text: Said before it plays, for people who can't see it.

form.videoLinkHelp.text: Copy it from Share under the video.

form.waiting.text: Waiting for a signal. What you filled in is kept here. Press Add it when you have one.

home.filesVanish.text: This server doesn't keep its files when it restarts. Ask {helper} to fix that.

home.notUpdated.text: Your site couldn't be updated. Your work is saved. Let {helper} know; the details are under Your site.

install.signInFirst.text: You'll sign in once more from the new icon, so have your password handy. If you don't know it, ask {helper} first.

item.abstractAbout.text: The short summary research posts start with.

item.buttonAbout.text: Takes readers to a page, an email or a phone number.

item.checklistAbout.text: Things to tick off, like what to buy.

item.codeAbout.text: A code block with a language, a title and highlighted lines.

item.codepenAbout.text: A pen shown in the post, by its address.

item.compareAbout.text: Two photos side by side, like the room before and after.

item.faqAbout.text: Questions readers ask. Each opens to show your answer.

item.footnoteAbout.text: A numbered note at the bottom of the post.

item.headingAbout.text: A short title that starts a new part of your post.

item.hoursAbout.text: The days and hours you're open.

item.linkAbout.text: To one of your posts or another website.

item.photoAbout.text: One of your photos, with a few words about it.

item.quizAbout.text: A quick quiz: readers pick an answer and find out if they're right.

item.referencesAbout.text: The list of works you cite, at the end.

item.runnableAbout.text: An example or a challenge readers edit and run.

item.tableAbout.text: Rows and columns, like sizes and prices.

item.tipAbout.text: A box that stands out, like “Book a week ahead.”

job.newerVersion.text: This job was saved by a newer version of your blog's pages. Reload to send it. If it still says this, tell {helper}.

kinds.collectionsAbout.text: A collection gathers posts on one page, like all your posts on one topic. Put a post in one from the post itself.

kinds.collectionsEmpty.text: A collection gathers posts on one page, like all your posts on one topic.

kinds.pagesAbout.text: Pages stay put, like About or Contact. Posts come and go by date.

look.notAccepted.text: Your site's settings didn't accept these choices. Your choices are still here; try a different one, or tell {helper}.

notify.canTurnOn.text: {helper} can turn them on. Your blog works the same without them.

notify.nameHelp.text: So you can tell them apart, like Work phone.

notify.nameMissing.text: Give it a name, like Work phone.

paste.kept.text: Pasted. Headings, bold and links kept. Fonts and colours left out.

paste.photoLeftMany.text: {count} photos were left out because they have no description. Put them in with Put a photo in.

paste.photoLeftOne.text: 1 photo was left out because it has no description. Put it in with Put a photo in.

photo.altHelp.text: For people who can't see it, like “A red front door with a wreath”.

quote.hostChose.text: {helper} chose this, so it can't be changed here.

recipe.askAddName.text: This recipe doesn't say who wrote it. Ask {helper} to add your name.

share.tellOrSkip.text: Tell {helper}, or choose Don't share it.

social.canTurnOn.text: {helper} can turn it on. Your site works the same without it.

social.facebookNoPage.text: Facebook didn't show any Page you can post to. You need to run the Page. If you do, ask {helper} to add you to its Facebook app.

social.noPlaces.text: {helper} needs to add Facebook or another place first.

social.orgsTruncated.text: LinkedIn sent only some of your company pages. If yours isn't here, tell {helper}.

social.pagesTruncated.text: Facebook sent only some of your Pages. If yours isn't here, tell {helper}.

social.signInAgain.text: {service} will ask you to sign in. Use the {service} account you used the first time. If {service} shows someone else's name, tell {helper}.

undo.askHelp.text: There's a new {one} with that name now. Ask {helper} to help bring this one back.

undo.mayFind.text: “{title}” can't come back from here. {helper} may still find it.

write.collectionHelp.text: Put it with others, like all your posts on one topic.
